in_sanskrit.name: Aveeth
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Breath of Life
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Aveeth एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Aveeth is derived from the Sanskrit word 'avyayah', meaning 'imperishable' or 'inexhaustible'. In Hindu mythology, the god Vayu is often referred to as 'Aveeth', symbolizing the breath of life. This name is believed to bring vitality, energy, and longevity.
